resources.string: This app reads Idena Social from the network itself, through a small node that runs on this phone: no company server in between. The first start takes a while.
Catching up with the latest blocks
Your phone does not download every block since the start: it downloads the block headers, then the network\'s latest state (a snapshot) from another node.
Create your account, or import the one you have, in the node panel. Save its key right away: it is the only way back into this account.
Sync is off: the node does not run, so nothing is read. Turn Sync on in the node panel.
Up to date. Reading Idena Social: the newest posts come first.
It can take several minutes, up to about 15, before a first node accepts yours. Keep the app open meanwhile.
On mobile data or a hotspot, other nodes often cannot reach your phone, and it finds peers slowly. Wi-Fi helps.
Your node waits for another node to send it the network\'s latest state. It goes on by itself once a peer offers it.
It has waited %1$d minutes: your peers do not offer the state yet. It still goes on by itself; more peers help (Wi-Fi, keeping the app open).
The node stops while the phone sleeps or when Android stops the app: it catches up with the blocks made meanwhile when it runs again.
Keep the app open during the first sync: Android may stop the node with the screen off. These settings let it run in the background.
